scope: two-node EP16 (8 GPUs/node) routed MoE; Qwen3.5 H2048/I512/E256/top8 BF16; source tokens per rank
measurement: Per-sample max across 16 ranks, then pooled p50; cached FWD ready / independent fresh-tape BWD gradients ready; host call through CUDA completion; fixed pools warmed; per-call packing/allocation included; routing projection/topk, adapter weight stack, shared expert, optimizer excluded
route_model: N(0,1) per-token logits + shared per-expert N(0,bias_std^2); top8; bias redrawn each invocation. balanced replaces routes with randomized complete periods.

communication.scope: Route-derived sum across all 16 ranks, decimal MB; not NIC measurements; excludes protocol and BWD dGate 4 bytes/row; not a per-GPU FWD rail-traffic model.
